summary: 4-8 tall industry slats stand side by side like the louvres of a shutter (CSS 3D): each turned slat shows a sliver of its photo (or a brand-tinted panel with a large icon) and a vertical title. Hovering, focusing or tapping a slat turns it to face the visitor with its short text; its neighbours fan away on both sides. One slat is always open; which one opens first, the width of the open slat and the fan angle are seeded from the brand name. Tablets and phones get a plain card list. Needs 4 or more industries from the brief; with fewer use industries-tiles.
